TailorBoost has developed an accurate and sustainable SEO optimization plan through in-depth research on industry trends, analysis of competitor data, and optimization of core keyword layout.

cases.title: ToB Enterprise SEO Optimization – Achieve leapfrog growth
cases.desc:
The client was a service provider for the enterprise (ToB) market, and the website faced problems such as slow traffic growth, limited customer acquisition channels, and insufficient brand exposure. TailorBoost has developed a high-performance growth SEO plan through in-depth analysis of industry needs, precise targeting of target customers, and optimization of website structure, content strategy, and keyword layout.
Within three months of optimization, the client's website saw an exponential increase in organic traffic, a significant jump in the ranking of core keywords, and a doubling of business opportunities, successfully achieving the goal of leapfrog growth. This result not only significantly improved the brand influence, but also brought high-quality potential customers to the company, helping the business to expand rapidly.
cases.goal: Core goal: to break through the bottleneck of growth and achieve leapfrog growth
cases.result: Optimization results: organic traffic has doubled, keyword rankings have been greatly improved, and customer acquisition efficiency has been significantly improved

cases.title: SEO Optimization for Startup Product-Based Businesses – Lay the groundwork for steady growth
cases.desc:
The customer is a product-oriented enterprise in the start-up stage, with a wide range of products, but the exposure of a single product is insufficient, and the overall traffic is scattered, which affects the brand influence and conversion effect. In response to this challenge, TailorBoost has developed a systematic SEO optimization plan, including product classification optimization, precise keyword layout, on-site content strategy, etc., aiming to lay a solid foundation and increase overall traffic.
After the optimization was implemented, the number of visits to the website increased significantly in just one month, and the search rankings of the core products continued to be optimized. In the following two months, despite the fluctuations in market traffic, the overall trend maintained a steady growth, helping the company establish a solid SEO foundation and lay a strong foundation for long-term growth in the future.
cases.goal: Core goal: to improve product exposure, lay a good SEO foundation, and achieve steady growth
cases.result: Optimization results: The number of visits increased rapidly, the keyword rankings were optimized, and the overall traffic rose steadily in fluctuations
